rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the act of turning to someone for help or advice.

example.english: When I come across something I don't understand, I usually have recourse to my teacher.
example.traditional: 遇到唔明嘅地方，我通常會求助老師。
example.jyutping: jyu6 dou3 m4 ming4 ge3 dei6 fong1 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 wui5 kau4 zo6 lou5 si1

rows.note: Use this when the recourse is specifically the final fallback or last measure.

example.english: If they still won't listen after we talk to them, calling the police is our last recourse.
example.traditional: 如果再勸都唔聽，報警就係最後一招。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 hyun3 dou1 m4 teng1 bou3 ging2 zau6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 ziu1

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing regarded as a source of support in a difficult situation.

example.english: After moving abroad, my friends were my main recourse for help.
example.traditional: 搬到外地之後，我只可以依靠朋友幫手。
example.jyutping: bun1 dou3 ngoi6 dei6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zi2 ho2 ji5 ji1 kaau3 pang4 jau5 bong1 sau2
